Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I didn't knew that I had to register for courses in November, so I had to do the after regestration in January.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: I had a contract person at QMU that I could contact.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I could unfortunately only take undergraduate classes, but otherwise I was succesfull with the registration.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Remember that the registration is in November.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I think that the levels where not challenging enough

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Unfortunately there where not many people who attend the lectures, because they videotape it. Therefore we where only 4-5 people for every lecture.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: ECN376: Finance of Emerging Markets, ECN358:Futures and Options,  ECN352: Public Economics and ECN375: Political Economics

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I can really recommend: Finance of Emerging Markets if you're a finance person.

questions.answer: Very easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: The local students are really outgoing, so if you just sit next them, they will be you friend.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: There is a lot of different culture at QMU as it's a multicultural university.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: They take every religious holiday into account.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1) Bring a lot of money, 2) Don't eat at the insta friendly places (the food is to pricy), 3) Remember to see other cities than London
